site.name: Stokes Healthcare Inc. dba Epicur Pharma

observations.title: Unapproved compounded animal drugs marketed on website
observations.summary: FDA found the firm markets compounded animal drugs that are not FDA‑approved, conditionally approved, or indexed, violating the FD&C Act’s adequate directions for use requirements.

observations.title: Misbranding of compounded omeprazole injection
observations.summary: The website makes false or misleading claims that the compounded omeprazole injection is safe, effective, comparable, or superior to FDA‑approved omeprazole products, which is untrue and misbrands the drug.

observations.title: Misbranding of compounded buprenorphine ER injection
observations.summary: The website asserts that the compounded buprenorphine ER injection is comparable or superior to FDA‑indexed products and falsely claims FDA indexing is underway and that the indexed product has a 2‑month shelf life.

observations.title: Failure to disclose risk information for compounded products
observations.summary: Promotional materials for the compounded buprenorphine and omeprazole products do not adequately communicate known safety risks, including buprenorphine’s Schedule III abuse potential and associated hazards.

observations.section: False or Misleading Advertising About FDA and the Legality of Compounded Animal Drugs
observations.title: False claim of compliance with GFI #256
observations.summary: The website states the buprenorphine ER injection solution is “Compliant with GFI #256,” which is false because the product is on the list of bulk drug substances not listed and does not meet GFI #256 recommendations.

observations.section: False or Misleading Advertising About FDA’s Oversight of Compounded Drugs
observations.title: False statement that Epicur tablets are manufactured to FDA specifications
observations.summary: The website claims all Epicur tablets are manufactured to FDA specifications, which is false because FDA does not set or approve specifications for compounded drugs.

observations.section: False or Misleading Advertising About the Legality of Compounded Animal Drugs
observations.title: Misleading claims about 503B exemption for animal drugs
observations.summary: The website asserts that animal drugs compounded in a 503B human drug outsourcing facility are legal for dispensing and unlimited hospital administration, which is false because the 503B exemptions apply only to human drugs.
